title: Lebanese Christian villages reject Netanyahu’s annexation claim in plea for state’s return

snapshot.title: Lebanese Christian villages reject Netanyahu’s annexation claim in plea for state’s return
snapshot.description: BEIRUT: Christian leaders in southern Lebanon have firmly rejected Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s claim that some border villages sought annexation by Israel, dismissing the remarks as an attempt to pressure the Lebanese authorities into disarming Hezbollah. Communities from about 13 Christian-majority border villages insisted their futures lie solely with the
snapshot.author: NAJIA HOUSSARI
